title: Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 Winners: Full Results List
content: The results for the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 are being announced today, celebrating the biggest anime series, films, characters, performances, and creators of the year. Winners are selected through a combination of global fan voting and input from an international judging panel.
author: Anime Corner

title: Ayanokoji Fights Nanase in Classroom of the Elite Season 4 Episode 12 Preview
content: Classroom of the Elite Season 4 revealed the Episode 2 preview, ahead of the episode’s May 27 premiere. The episode teases a fight between Kiyotaka Ayanokoji and Tsubasa Nanase, as well as showing numerous other characters who will be appearing.
author: Anime Corner

title: 14 Years Later, Naruto’s Final War Gets a New Official Release
content: Masashi Kishimoto’s beloved Weekly Shonen Jump series Naruto has one of the most unique power systems in Shonen. The series is still loved among global fans thanks to its captivating story, intriguing characters, and thrilling fights.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Action Series Unveils New Look At Beloved Characters Amid Season 3 Delay
content: Wind Breaker is one of the most acclaimed high school action series in recent years. The anime is based on the ongoing manga by Satoru Nii, which began serialization in Kodansha’s Magazine pocket . The anime originally debuted in 2024 and released a sequel a year later, both of which became major hits on Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook

title: Netflix’s Most Anticipated Release of 2026 Unveils Exciting Update Ahead of Its Debut
content: Ever since the year began, Netflix has been dropping one exciting anime series after another, including Love Through a Prism, Cosmic Princess Kaguya, Baki-Dou: The Invincible Samurai, and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Shonen Series Reveals New Look Ahead of Finale
content: Based on the award-winning manga written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, Dr. Stone ’s anime adaptation is all set for its finale as it returns with part 3 of its final season this week, as part of the Spring 2026 lineup.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Reveals First Official Trailer of a New Project
content: Whether it’s the palace drama or the mysteries, fans can experience it all in the first simulation game based on the beloved anime, The Apothecary Diaries . The anime concluded its second season in July 2025 before announcing a Season 3 and an upcoming feature film.
author: ComicBook

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Returns With a New Anime Ahead of Season 3
content: The exciting Season 2 of Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End reached its conclusion in March this year after teasing the manga’s best arc yet. The series continues the journey of Frieren and her party as they continue their travels to the North after Fern became a First Class Mage.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Creator Shares Major Live-Action Season 3 Update
content: It’s been a month since Netflix’s One Piece live-action Season 2 was released, and the hype around the series hasn’t died down at all. After making fans wait for more than two years, the sequel season follows the Straw Hat Pirates’ journey into the Grand Line, where they meet new allies and enemies.
author: ComicBook

title: Yen Press Licenses Wistoria: Wand and Sword, Honey Lemon Soda Novels, 7 Manga
content: Yen Press announced on Friday during its panel at this year's Anime North event that it has licensed seven manga and two novel series for release in December 2026 and winter 2027. A prequel to the smash hit manga series written by the original author!
author: ANN
